description: The plot illustrates the relative change across different layers for various configurations, comparing their performance relative to a baseline. The x-axis represents the layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) on a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change," with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, marked at intervals of 5%. The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit" in red with a solid line, "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit" in light blue with a solid line, "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit" in dark blue with a solid line, and "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit" in grey with a dashed line. The red line starts at approximately 0% and remains relatively stable around -1% across the x-axis. The light blue line begins at around -1.5%, decreases to about -6% at Layer13-20, and then increases to roughly -1% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line starts at around -2%, drops to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, and then rises to about -1% by Layer29-32. The grey dashed line remains constant at 0% across all layer ranges.
